name: tripplanner
description: Collaborative Wanderlog-style trip planning companion. Connects Antigravity (agy) sessions directly to the live Web UI, SQLite/D1 database, route optimizer, Splitwise budget settlement, and reservations ledger.
suggestedPrompts: Show me what is currently selected in my TripPlanner UI session
Add Kinkaku-ji temple to Day 2 afternoon and highlight it on the map
Optimize our Day 1 walking itinerary to minimize travel time
